svg.title: M330 Aspect Wheel, anchor P6
svg.desc: Coordinate specification (M330, Core Part 3.56). System: the canonical 24-cycle of Omega42, V335 Rev.450 STABLE. Nodes: P0 to P23, the positions of the canonical orbit, the orbit of (2, 5) under T(a, b) = (b, a + b) mod 9. Values: the number beside each node is its orbit value, 2 5 7 3 1 4 5 9 5 5 1 6 7 4 2 6 8 5 4 9 4 4 8 3. Ordering: clockwise from the top, P0 at 0 degrees. Geometry: 15 degrees a step, a display of the cycle; angle carries the step count and nothing more. Directions: from the anchor A, Yang to A + 5, Yin to A + 18, 4D to A + 8, Antipode to A + 12 (mod 24). Anchor: the filled point, P6, fixed by the canonical computation of the strike (Core Parts 1.3 and 1.4; scripts/canonical_reference.py). Provenance: tools/wheel.py --strike TEXT --svg FILE.
svg.text: Nodes P0-P23: the canonical orbit; number = orbit value; clockwise from top, 15 degrees a step.
Filled point: the anchor P6 of the strike. Lines: Yang A+5, Yin A+18, 4D A+8, Antipode A+12.
Angle shows the step count only (Core Part 3.56). Full specification in the desc element of this file.
